title: Duplicate party detection and supervised resolution
workflow: Normalize permissible names and identifiers under local data policy
Run exact checks and privacy-safe similarity candidate discovery
Present evidence features and uncertainty to authorized reviewer
Confirm shared or different identity without disclosing unrelated institution data
If approved, consolidate references under versioned merge with complete audit and reversibility plan
Notify impacted relationship/account owners and verify reference integrity
rules: A matching phone number or name is insufficient for automatic merge
Never merge two legal entities solely because their trade names are identical
Duplicate flags cannot trigger unilateral account closure or balance movement
Do not perform cross-institution biometric or PII matching without explicitly authorized legal basis
Preserve historical identifiers and original source provenance after approved resolution
Merges require maker-checker and planned reconciliation for affected external references
planned_test_cases: Two customers with shared phone remain separate pending review
Different legal registries with equal local IDs are not auto-merged
Merge without independent approval is blocked
All prior audit references remain resolvable after merge
Cross-institution duplicate search does not leak candidate identities
acceptance_gate: Approved deduplication policy, privacy impact review, reference migration safeguards and supervised reviewer identities.
